instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot capturing an indoor motion capture studio with white walls and a red carpet. On the left, the woman in a white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right. On the right, the bearded man in a black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) is seen from behind, facing left and reaching his right hand forward to touch her right shoulder. The background features a white radiator and camera stands. The overhead indoor lighting casts soft shadows on the red carpet, creating a neutral, functional atmosphere.
